audit.whatIsWrong: The entry states four separate times that Lightslinger fires through the blind: 'even a blinded auto triggers the double-shot proc', 'his passive double-shot procs off a single auto even through your Blinding Shot', 'he gets a free proc before your blind takes effect', and 'his passive proc shreds you in two autos regardless of blind'. Lightslinger reads: 'Whenever Lucian uses an ability, his next attack becomes a double-shot.' It IS a basic attack, and blind makes basic attacks miss.
audit.why: This is the most damaging error I found across my whole slice. It tells a Teemo that his single defining ability does not work against the one champion it works best against, and the conclusion drawn from it — 'do not open with an auto', 'you lose teamfights regardless of blind', Lucian taking six of seven chart stages — is all downstream of a mechanic that does not exist.
audit.corrected: Blinding Dart deletes the Lightslinger double-shot outright, because the double-shot is a basic attack. Blind AFTER he casts, not before: the ability is what loads the attack.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lucian.json (P Lightslinger: 'his next attack becomes a double-shot')

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing states that Relentless Pursuit's cooldown is reduced by Lightslinger attacks, or gives its real cooldown (16/15.5/15/14.5/14).
audit.why: This is the compounding half of the blind interaction and the best piece of tech in the matchup. Blinding the Lightslinger attack does not just remove the damage — it also denies the cooldown reduction on his dash, so his only escape stays down near its full 16 seconds. One blind buys two separate advantages.
audit.corrected: Relentless Pursuit starts at a 16s cooldown and only comes down when his Lightslinger attacks land. Blind them and his dash stays gone.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lucian.json (E: 'Lightslinger attacks reduce Relentless Pursuit's cooldown', cd 16/15.5/15/14.5/14)

audit.whatIsWrong: Ardent Blaze reveals enemies, and neither layer mentions it. The content gestures at the effect ('he fires into the brush the moment you hold still too long') but attributes it to ordinary poke.
audit.why: Guerrilla Warfare invisibility is the tool Teemo uses to disengage and to set up, and Lucian strips it from 900 range on a 14-to-10s cooldown. The mark also grants him move speed for attacking marked targets, which is how he closes after revealing you — so the reveal and the chase are one motion, not two.
audit.corrected: Ardent Blaze marks and reveals from 900, and attacking a marked target speeds him up. Invisibility is not cover against him and standing still in brush is not safe.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lucian.json (W Ardent Blaze, revealsStealth, range 900, cd 14/13/12/11/10)

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability names are crossed: 'Lucian's Q linear shot and W piercing light' (Piercing Light IS the Q; W is Ardent Blaze) and 'Q lightslinger poke' (Lightslinger is the passive).
audit.why: Both of the abilities the sentence is trying to describe end up mislabelled, so a player cannot map the advice onto anything he sees on screen.
audit.corrected: Q Piercing Light, 500 range. W Ardent Blaze, 900 range. Lightslinger is the passive.

audit.whatIsWrong: Piercing Light pierces through its target, and nothing says so.
audit.why: It means Lucian can target a minion and have the bolt continue into you — so standing directly behind your own wave is the worst place to stand, which is the opposite of the usual instinct for a ranged laner staying safe behind minions.
audit.corrected: He casts Q on a minion and the bolt carries through into whoever is lined up behind it. Stand off the line, not behind the wave.
sources: champ-data/_kits/lucian.json (Q: 'shoots a bolt of piercing light through a target')

audit.whatIsWrong: The content level chart gives Lucian six of seven stages while the packet shows 50.19% over 1291 games — the largest sample on this champion — and the entry's own 'late' text says 'The 50% win rate is real'. The full layer's chart meanwhile gives Teemo three stages and Skill three.
audit.why: The entry acknowledges the matchup is even in prose and then draws a chart that says it is badly losing. Both cannot ship. Most of the chart's pessimism traces directly to the blind-does-not-work error above, so correcting that mechanic should move the chart with it.
audit.corrected: Reporting rather than flipping six sides. But the premise the chart was built on is wrong, and it should be redrawn after the Lightslinger correction lands.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer names Relentless Pursuit as the matchup-defining cooldown to track and to blind ('blind his Relentless Pursuit'). Relentless Pursuit is a dash — blind does nothing to it.
audit.why: The tracked cooldown is right for a different reason (it is his only escape) but the instruction attached to it is impossible, and the thing that actually should be blinded — the Lightslinger attack — is never named in the full layer at all.
audit.corrected: Track Relentless Pursuit as his escape. Blind the Lightslinger attack, which is what suppresses it in the first place.

audit.why: Checked and had nothing to add. The rune and summoner recommendations in the full layer are generic across Teemo's whole file rather than tuned to Lucian, but nothing in them is wrong, so I am not proposing speculative changes.

edits.before: At level 1 Lucian wins: his passive double-shot procs off a single auto even through your Blinding Shot, meaning he gets free burst damage the moment you try to trade. Do not open with an auto into his Q poke — take E first, stay at max poison range, and accept that he sets the tone. Your Q matters most as a reaction tool: save it for when he walks up to trade, not as an opener he can play around. His E dash is on a long cooldown at level 1, so if you land a blind and he has no escape, he takes the full poison stack; that is your only real level-1 leverage.
edits.after: Level 1 is Lucian's, but not for the reason usually given: Lightslinger loads his NEXT basic attack after any ability, and a basic attack is precisely what Blinding Dart erases. The order matters — blind after he casts, never before. Stay at max poison range and let him set the tone while you have only one point in Q, then take your trades once the pattern is readable. His Relentless Pursuit is 16s at rank 1 and only ticks down when his Lightslinger attacks land, so a blind that eats one is also a blind that keeps his single escape gone for the rest of the trade.

edits.before: Level 2 is your fleeting window: E online means a poison trade into W retreat that he cannot match without burning his E. After that, Lucian's Q linear shot and W piercing light give him enough poke reach to punish your camouflage approach — he fires into the brush the moment you hold still too long. Mushroom the tribush at level 6 so his E does not give him a free flank angle; if he burns E into a shroom slow, that is the one moment to W-chase and layer poison stacks. Do not fight him in an open lane segment where he can E in any direction — funnel him into the chokepoints your traps control.
edits.after: Level 2 is your window: a poison trade into a Move Quick retreat that he cannot match without burning E. After that Piercing Light (Q, 500 range) travels through a minion into whoever is lined up behind it, so standing behind your own wave is the worst place to stand, and Ardent Blaze (W, 900 range) marks and reveals you — invisibility is not cover against him, and holding still in brush is not safe either. Mushroom the tribush at 6 so his E has no free flank angle, and funnel him into the chokepoints your traps control instead of fighting in open lane where the dash goes any direction he likes.

edits.before: Your split-push is the realistic win condition: Liandry's DoT with shroom fields forces him to spend E charges checking bushes instead of pressuring you, and his low range for a carry means he cannot safely poke you from outside mushroom detonation radius in a warded side lane. In teamfights you lose — his passive proc shreds you in two autos regardless of blind if he has items. Stay in the sidelane, shroom every brush he could flank through, and force him to 1v1 in a corridor where E gives him nowhere useful to go. The 50% win rate is real: you will not dominate this lane, but a clean split-push execution beats the ranged bully by taking the map away from him.
edits.after: Split-push is the realistic win condition: Liandry's DoT plus shroom fields forces him to spend Relentless Pursuit checking bushes instead of pressuring you, and every one he spends is 16 seconds he cannot get back unless his Lightslinger attacks are landing. Teamfights are harder, but not because blind fails — it works fine on the double-shot; the problem is that one blind cannot cover a whole fight. Stay in the side lane, shroom every brush he could flank through, and make him duel in a corridor where the dash has nowhere useful to go. The 50% win rate is real: you will not dominate this lane, but a clean split beats him on the map.

notes: TOP PRIORITY ACROSS MY WHOLE SLICE: this entry asserts four times that Lucian's Lightslinger double-shot fires through Teemo's blind ('even a blinded auto triggers the double-shot proc' ... 'shreds you in two autos regardless of blind'). Lightslinger explicitly makes his NEXT ATTACK a double-shot, so blind removes it. The entire pessimistic framing of the matchup — Lucian on six of seven chart stages against a 50.19% win rate over 1291 games, the largest sample on this champion — rests on that invented mechanic. Fixing the mechanic without redrawing the chart leaves the page self-contradictory, so please treat the chart as a follow-up. ALSO A TOOLING FLAG: champ-data/_kits/_missing-interactions.json lists 'needs-antiheal — Lucian sustains through chip damage (Lightslinger (P))' for this matchup. That is a false positive. Lightslinger's heal/shield clause is 'When Lucian is healed or shielded by an ALLY' — it is not self-sustain and there is no ally in a top-lane 1v1, so Grievous Wounds is not a matchup requirement here. I did not write anti-heal advice into this entry. Champion-wide name defects still outstanding: "Blinding Shot" x271 (should be Blinding Dart) and "Liandry's Angueur" x80 in champ-data/content/teemo.js.
